categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the Private Broadcast label prior and directly affects transaction relay privacy over the network.
categories.rationale: Fixes a privacy leak in transaction origin relay where periodic wallet rebroadcasts bypass private broadcast settings. When -privatebroadcast=1 is enabled, the node still rebroadcast unconfirmed transactions using the send-to-all path every 12 to 36 hours, leaking the node's IP address over regular peer connections.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies unconfirmed transaction resubmission logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents wallet rebroadcast logic from undermining user privacy when private broadcasting is requested. The PR description notes that transactions submitted with -privatebroadcast=1 would previously fall back to public rebroadcasts, deanonymizing wallet transaction origin over time.
